fire: Rain fell all day on the streets of Dublin.
Crowds came to Kilkenny for the arts festival.
Fishing boats return to Galway bay at dusk.
Hurling matches draw huge crowds in Cork.
As everyone knows, Irish whiskey is distilled three times.
The ferry to Ireland leaves from Holyhead.
Sheep graze on the hills of Connemara.
The Irish parliament met in Leinster House.
